pages.description: Finn waves from a wooden dock in this printable coloring page, wearing his backpack and an animal-faced hat beside a lake surrounded by hills. The coloring sheet includes individual dock planks, round support posts, shoreline reeds, and small ripples, with open water around his full standing figure.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Standing Near Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Finn beside a two-tier waterfall, smiling and raising one hand while standing on a rocky ledge above the water. His backpack and simple outfit have broad coloring spaces, while cracks in the surrounding rocks, splashes, grass tufts, and distant trees add finer details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Exploring in Pumpkin Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: Finn explores a pumpkin patch in this printable coloring page, stepping along a winding path with a walking stick and a sword behind his backpack. Large pumpkins frame the foreground of the coloring sheet, and their curved ribs, curling vines, and pointed leaves provide details around his open clothing shapes.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Posing in Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Finn posing in a bamboo grove, smiling with one hand on his hip and the other raised beside tall stalks. Segmented bamboo trunks and narrow pointed leaves create repeated shapes throughout the coloring sheet, with small rocks and grass beneath his boots and backpack.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Walking in Kingdom Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Finn walks through a kingdom courtyard in this printable coloring page, carrying his backpack along a curving stone path between candy-themed houses and trees. The coloring sheet surrounds his simple figure with a flag-topped castle tower, striped candy cane trunks, rounded shrubs, and separate paving stones of different sizes.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Posing in Gemstone Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Finn posing with both hands on his hips in a gemstone mine, wearing a backpack with a rolled bedroll. Faceted crystals project from the cave walls and floor of the coloring sheet, while a loaded mine cart, rail tracks, wooden supports, and a hanging lantern complete the setting.

pages.title: Adventure Time Finn Posing Inside Castle Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: Finn raises a sword and clenched fist inside a castle hall in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath ceiling beams beside tall arched windows. Stone floor tiles, a wooden door, a wall torch, and part of a hanging banner give the coloring sheet architectural details around his bold central outline.
